source.title: Accredited Labs in Minnesota Accepting Drinking Water Samples from Private Well Users, Minnesota Department of Health, July 2026
notes: The PDF is MDH's compiled list of accredited laboratories that accept samples from private well owners and are certified to test for arsenic, coliform bacteria, lead, manganese, and/or nitrate.
An asterisk on a test means the sample is subcontracted to a laboratory accredited for that analyte.
MDH: laboratories held valid accreditation at the time the map was created. This is not an endorsement. Other labs may hold accreditation.
MDH contact: MNELAP 651-201-5324 or health.mnelap@state.mn.us. Well Policy Center 651-201-5594 or health.privatewells@state.mn.us.
